scientific_scope_status: The source constructs torque-neutral signed wave forcing and a conditional stochastic phase-control model for positioning a naturally sustained protective zonal flow. Its exact model power can scale with phase-restoration demand rather than full amplitude damping, while the actual wave-to-mode interface and matched confinement benefit remain open.
